Its initial release format was as a podcast. "An official boot leg from the block keys that's hard-ro, and early single, captured in Austin, Texas on October 24, 2003, back in a moment."

podcast.body: An official bootleg album, despite being recorded in a bootleg style, it was released with the band's approval. It captures a show played on October 24, 2003, at Emo's in Austin, Texas, during their tour for the *Thickfreakness* album. Notably, its initial release was as a podcast. "It's simply called Live in Austin, and dates all the way back to a show they played in October 24, 2003, at a place called Emo's when the band was touring the Thick Freakness album."
